data.value: Download an authenticator app such as {0}, {1}, or {2}.

data.value: Important: Store these recovery codes in a secure place. Each code can only be used once. If you lose access to your authenticator app, you can use a recovery code to sign in.

data.value: Disabling 2FA will reduce the security of your account. Your authenticator key will be reset.

data.value: Enter your current authenticator code to confirm you wish to disable 2FA:

data.value: You can't turn off 2FA while you have passkeys. Remove your passkeys first, then turn off 2FA.

data.value: This operation requires recent two-factor authentication verification. Please enter the current code from your authenticator app.

data.name: LoginTwoFactorDescription
data.value: Your login is protected with an authenticator app. Enter the 6-digit code from your app below.

data.name: RememberBrowserLabel
data.value: Don't ask again on this device for 30 days

data.name: UseRecoveryCodeLink
data.value: Lost access to your app? Use a recovery code

data.name: RecoveryCodeLoginDescription
data.value: You have lost access to your authenticator app. Enter one of your recovery codes below. Each recovery code can only be used once.

data.name: ReplaceInstructions
data.value: Scan this new key with the authenticator app you want to use, then enter a code from it. When you confirm, your old authenticator stops working, new recovery codes are issued, and every device is signed out.

data.name: ReplaceAndSignOutButton
data.value: Verify, Replace and Sign Out Everywhere

data.name: SignInAgainNotice
data.value: Your authenticator was replaced and every session was signed out. Save these recovery codes, then sign in again with your new authenticator.

data.name: PasskeysDescription
data.value: A passkey verifies you with your device's screen lock or a security key. Each passkey works only in the app it was added in; add one here for the web. Removing a passkey stops it working at Resgrid at once, although it may stay on the device or in your password manager.

data.name: PasskeysAddButton
data.value: Add a passkey for the web

data.name: PasskeysUnavailable
data.value: Adding passkeys for the web is not available on this deployment yet.

data.name: PasskeysNeedAuthenticator
data.value: Set up an authenticator app, and keep recovery codes, before adding a passkey.

data.name: PasskeyRemoveConfirm
data.value: Remove this passkey? It stops working at Resgrid at once, and sessions that signed in with it end.

data.name: PasskeyCancelled
data.value: The passkey prompt was closed. Nothing was changed.

data.name: PasskeyNotSupported
data.value: This browser cannot use passkeys. Use your authenticator app instead.

data.name: PasskeyFailed
data.value: The passkey could not be used. Try again, or use your authenticator app.

data.name: PasskeyLimitReached
data.value: You already have the most passkeys allowed for the web. Remove one first.

data.name: PasskeyAlreadyRegistered
data.value: This device or security key already holds a passkey for your account in this app.

data.value: Sign in with a password instead

data.value: Enter your username or your department's code.

data.value: That sign-in could not be matched to this browser. Start again.

data.value: Single sign-on took too long. Start again.

data.value: Your department requires multi-factor authentication, and this account has none yet. Ask your administrator how to set it up.

data.value: Testing the mapping needs a recent verification with your authenticator app or a passkey.

data.name: FederatedMfaTestFailed
data.value: The test sign-in did not carry a value the mapping counts as MFA. Check the mapping and your identity provider, then test again.

data.name: FederatedMfaTestChanged
data.value: The mapping changed during the test. Test it again.

data.name: FederatedMfaTestPassed
data.value: The mapping passed its test and is now in effect.

data.name: LoginMfaSetupDescription
data.value: Your department requires a second factor, and this account does not have one yet. Set up an authenticator app to finish signing in.

data.name: SetupExpired
data.value: The setup code expired. A new one is shown; scan it again.

data.name: LostFactorWithCodeDescription
data.value: If you saved your recovery codes, enter one to set up a new authenticator app and remove passkeys you have lost. Every session signs out, and you then sign in again.

data.name: LostFactorSignInFirst
data.value: To use a recovery code, sign in with your password or single sign-on first, then choose "I lost my authenticator".

data.name: LostFactorNoCodeDescription
data.value: Resgrid cannot reset a lost authenticator automatically. Ask your department's administrators to contact Resgrid support, who confirm who you are with your department before anything changes. Keep following your department's own procedures until then.

data.name: RecoveryDescription
data.value: Set up your new authenticator app and enter the code it shows. Choose any passkeys you have lost; they will be removed.

data.name: RecoveryCompleteDescription
data.value: Every session has signed out. Save your new recovery codes, then sign in again with your new authenticator.

data.name: RecoveryEnded
data.value: This recovery is no longer valid. Sign in and start again.

data.name: RecoveryUnavailable
data.value: Recovery is temporarily unavailable. Sign in and try again with another recovery code.

data.name: RecoveryPasskeyNotFound
data.value: One of the passkeys to remove is not yours or is already removed.

data.value: Use this browser as a shared workstation

data.value: A name for support, such as "Dispatch desk 2". It identifies the station, not a person.
